notes: ✨ The Today page now wears the app's own design. Yesterday's new Starter cards used their own ad-hoc styling and it showed — wrong font, wrong sizes, nothing lining up with the cards below them. Rebuilt on the app's native card grammar: the same rounded cards, Inter typeface, title weights and section labels as the rest of Starter. The robot's money is now a proper stat row — Started with · Worth now · Change · Holding — instead of one crowded sentence, the ON/OFF chip sits neatly in the card header, its recent trades read as clean divided rows, the brief greets you with Good morning or Good afternoon, and the style buttons and links all match the app's buttons. Nothing about what the cards say or do changed — only how they look.
